A '''Palawa tunic''' was a form-fitting tunic worn by the [[Followers of Palawa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]]. The [[Pike Sisters]], having studied on Bunduki, wore the tunics of their Palawa teachers in their careers as professional fighters, as the tunic allowed them freedom of movement.<ref name="SotES" /> [[Arden Lyn]], a [[Steel Hand of Palawa]]<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> active in [[24,500 BBY]],<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> was likewise known to have worn a Palawa tunic.<ref name="TEP" />
